name: docs-demo-docker-compose-intercept-yml-00
yaml:
# Rift Demo - HTTPS intercept proxy, standalone
#
# A system under test in its own container sends its HTTPS traffic through rift's intercept
# listener (HTTPS_PROXY). Rift terminates TLS with a CA the SUT already trusts, and a rule forwards
# cdn.optimizely.com to an imposter that serves a datafile from disk. Nothing calls the admin API:
# the config file declares the imposter, the listener and the rule.
#
# Prerequisites (the CA must exist before either container starts):
#   ./generate-intercept-ca.sh
#
# Quick Start:
#   docker compose -f docker-compose-intercept.yml up -d --wait
#   ./test-intercept.sh          # edits the datafile, reloads, and shows the SUT sees the change
#
# The intercept port (8080) is deliberately not published: the SUT reaches it over the compose
# network, as a SUT in another container (or another ECS task container) would.

services:
  rift:
    image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
    container_name: rift-intercept-demo
    ports:
      - "2525:2525"    # Admin API
    volumes:
      - ./imposters-intercept.json:/config/imposters-intercept.json:ro
      - ./fixtures:/config/fixtures:ro
      - ./intercept-ca:/intercept-ca:ro
    command: ["--configfile", "/config/imposters-intercept.json"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rift", "healthcheck"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  # The system under test: plain curl, configured only by environment, the way an app container
  # is. Its healthcheck is the assertion CI enforces: the datafile arrives through the MITM.
  sut:
    image: curlimages/curl:8.11.1
    container_name: rift-intercept-demo-sut
    depends_on:
      rift:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - HTTPS_PROXY=http://rift:8080
    volumes:
      - ./intercept-ca/ca-cert.pem:/certs/rift-ca.pem:ro
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "sh", "-c", "curl -fsS --cacert /certs/rift-ca.pem https://cdn.optimizely.com/datafiles/demo.json | grep -q '\"revision\"'"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 6
